| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Latitude** | `37.4224764` |

If you’d like to verify or look up what’s at that location, you can use the Google Maps Geocoding API (or any other reverse‑geocoding service) with a request like this:

```
https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/geocode/json?latlng=37.4224764,-122.0842499&key=YOUR_API_KEY
```

That will return a JSON response containing the formatted address, place ID, and other details. In this case, the coordinates point to the Googleplex in Mountain View, California.
